compute_is_valid_response: compute the split-is-valid response for a dataset config and split checking viewer preview search filter and statistics
run_SplitIsValidJobRunner_compute: run the SplitIsValidJobRunner compute method to get a CompleteJobResult with the is-valid response for a dataset split
get_SplitIsValidJobRunner_job_type: get the job type string from SplitIsValidJobRunner which returns split-is-valid for identifying the runner
check_dataset_split_validity: check if a HuggingFace dataset split has valid viewer preview search filter and statistics artifacts using compute_is_valid_response
determine_indexable_columns_for_search: determine if a dataset split supports search by checking indexable columns from parquet metadata features using get_indexable_columns
